SELECT e.id, e.actor_user_id, u.display_name AS actor_name, e.actor_type, e.action, e.object_type, e.object_id, e.outcome, e.request_id, e.changes_json, e.occurred_at FROM audit_events e LEFT JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND m.user_id = e.actor_user_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT e.id, e.actor_user_id, u.display_name AS actor_name, e.actor_type, e.action, e.object_type, e.object_id, e.outcome, e.request_id, e.changes_json, e.occurred_at FROM audit_events e LEFT JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND m.user_id = e.actor_user_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{id}
